tasks.description: Enforce rate limits using a token-bucket algorithm scoped to each API key. This will ensure that each key gets an independent allowance. The algorithm should be designed to handle a high volume of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API key, when the token-bucket algorithm is applied, then the rate limit is enforced correctly.

tasks.description: Make the bucket capacity and refill rate configurable via application configuration. This will allow for easy adjustment of the rate limits without requiring code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration file, when the bucket capacity and refill rate are updated, then the new values are reflected in the rate-limiting middleware.

tasks.description: Store rate-limit counters/state in Redis to ensure that limits are enforced consistently across all server instances. This will require setting up a Redis connection and implementing the necessary logic to store and retrieve the counters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Redis connection, when a counter is stored, then the counter is correctly retrieved from Redis.

tasks.description: When a key exceeds its limit, reject the request with an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status. This will inform the client that they have exceeded the rate limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API key that has exceeded its rate limit, when a request is made, then a 429 response is returned.

tasks.description: Include a `Retry-After` header on 429 responses indicating how long the client should wait before retrying. This will help the client to understand when they can make another request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 429 response, when the Retry-After header is included, then the header contains the correct value.

tasks.description: Integrate the rate-limiting middleware with the existing API routes. This will require setting up the middleware to sit in front of the API routes and applying the rate limits uniformly to authenticated API traffic keyed by API key.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API request, when the rate-limiting middleware is applied, then the rate limit is enforced correctly.

tasks.description: Test the rate-limiting functionality to ensure that it is working correctly. This will involve testing different scenarios, such as exceeding the rate limit and verifying the 429 response.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test scenario, when the rate-limiting functionality is tested, then the expected behavior is observed.
